coverage.summary: On October 11, 2026, we captured 6,978 unique public review entries across 14 source apps; 2,231 were rated one to three stars. The audit requested pages 1–10 of Apple's most-recent and most-helpful feeds in the United States, Canada, Great Britain and Australia. All 400 requested feed snapshots succeeded.
coverage.boundary: Apple caps these public feeds at ten pages. Two source apps filled page 10, so older reviews may exist beyond what Apple exposed. This is every verified complaint category Open Flashcards claims to address—not every review ever written.
